build.host_note: Unchanged Runtime 009 Host; Runtime 012 changes WSL Moss page default + hash-bound v3 art/choreography only.

description: Persistent plug-and-play MCP activity dashboard for the owner's exact Ditoo Plus; Runtime 002 adds telemetry-only live session observability. Runtime 003 re-binds the policy to the session-profile Host build. Runtime 004 re-binds the policy to the Host build with a separate streaming-profile ceiling. Runtime 006 adds physical-button pagination: the Ditoo's left/right arrows page through a wrap-around list (dashboard first), a short lever pull runs the current page's own action, input from the receive-only ButtonProbe (SMTC, mirror status) run as a child of the product. Runtime 007: Host re-bind only: the candidate Host sends every session's FIRST frame with the proven 10 ms packet spacing (first-frame IMAGE_RX_RECV_TIMEOUT: 5/19 streaming_ack_clock opens vs 0/199 activity opens, captures/OPENDITOO-STREAMING-FIRST-FRAME-TIMEOUT-ANALYSIS-2026-09-10.json); later frames keep the profile spacing. Build is path-independent (PathMap). Runtime 008 (HF-4): every page (dashboard with the UI-1 lightning pulse, three-reel slots) in ONE streaming_ack_clock Host session (PageCarousel); Left/Right change pixels only; InteractiveTransport pacing (50 ms client floor + 45 ms Host-anchored gap); Host-confirmed stock yield reclaims the same page; hidden-page collection on a joined worker. Accepted as OPENDITOO-INTERACTIVE-HF3-008 (11 cycles, 66/66 inputs, 0 faults). Runtime 009: exactly Runtime 008 plus owner-review fixes: the lightning glow draws only the icon's own pixels (no lone above-icon 'spark' after the hit), and a session's first ACK is always persisted to telemetry. Runtime 010 successor adds Pocket Moss as the third single-session page plus generic page-first modal Left/Right capture; all Moss art/animation sources and the Pixel Animation Lab compiler are hash-bound. Runtime 010 was subsequently cut over and is the live rollback baseline for Runtime 011. Runtime 011 is an art-readability-only successor: Moss v2 replaces the physically ambiguous v1 brown silhouette; transport and interaction semantics are unchanged. Runtime 012 is a polish-only successor: Moss v3 keeps the successful v2 identity while adding depth shading and richer authored Dance/Pet/Kisses choreography; product-control semantics remain unchanged. Runtime 013 is an art/animation-only successor: Moss v4 keeps the v2/v3 face identity with a front-facing seated body, directional shading, a teal collar and richer authored motion; product-control semantics remain unchanged. Runtime 014 is a Slots-only polish successor: Slots v2 snaps every lever stop to the next symbol on the payline (bounded ACK-paced brake + 1 px bounce), adds reachable win rules (left+middle pair, three of a kind, 7-7-7 jackpot) with bounded outcome animations, and redraws the reels with shaded symbols, a dimmed off-payline window and a gold payline marker; product-control semantics remain unchanged. Runtime 015 is a Slots aim-tuning successor: a lever stop lands on the symbol nearest the payline (slipping back up to 3 px to absorb input lag) instead of always the next one, and the middle/right reels slow from 2 to an average 1.5 px/frame; odds under random timing are unchanged. Runtime 016 is a Slots motion-smoothing successor: every reel moves a steady 1 px per ACKed frame (Runtime 015's alternating 1/2 px middle/right steps juddered when an ACK arrived late), and aim difficulty moves to a per-reel slip-back window (3 px left, 2 px middle/right); odds under random timing are unchanged.

install.startup_boundary: Windows user logon / StartWhenAvailable; WSL is user-scoped, so this is the reliable Windows startup boundary

pages.lever: stop the next reel; after the third, start a new round
pages.name: slots

pages.lever: normal: enter selector; selector: execute Pet/Dance/Kisses/Back
pages.name: moss

broker.device_attribution: ACL handle learned at runtime from OpenDitoo outbound image preamble A->B; unbound on HCI disconnect; no handle/CID persistence
broker.lifetime: one elevated sidecar per product run via the on-demand scheduled task (MultipleInstances IgnoreNew); Job Object kills ButtonProbe/BTVS/tshark when the broker exits; broker exits 15 s after the WSL lease stops changing; WSL run request at most once/5s; Playing sink starts on first handle bind; ETW backlog captured before broker start is dropped; BTETWRTSession flush-only every 50 ms
broker.media_keys: SMTC Playing is ownership sink only; page/game input comes exclusively from inbound raw AVRCP presses on the learned Ditoo handle

launch.why: BTVS requires elevation; only this sidecar is elevated, from admin-only copies with fixed policy-derived arguments. The WSL runtime stays unelevated and can only run the task and refresh its lease.

navigation.lever_candidate: current page's lever action; long holds are never mapped (BTN-7)
navigation.nav_left: previous page, wrapping, pixels only (same Host session)
navigation.nav_right: next page, wrapping, pixels only (same Host session)
